nn.BCELoss() # Binary as either antibody binds or not\n", " optimiser = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr = lr, weight_decay = 1e-4) # Smaller dataset\n", "\n", " iters, epch = [],[]\n", " losses = epoch in range(num_epochs):\n", " model.train()\n", " running_loss = 0.0\n", " for ab, ag, lab in train_dloader:\n", " ab = ab.to(device)\n", " ag = ag.to(device)\n", " lab = lab.to(device)\n", "\n", " # Forward pass\n", " optimiser.zero_grad()\n", " out = model(ab, ag)\n", " loss = criterion(out,lab)\n", "\n", " running_loss += loss.item()\n", "\n", " # Backward pass, parameter update\n", " loss.backward()\n", " optimiser.step()\n", "\n", " iters.append(n)\n", " losses.append(loss.item())\n", " n += 1\n", "\n", " # End of epoch\n", " ep += 1\n", " epch.append(ep)\n", "\n", " train_auc = evaluation(model, train_dloader)['AUROC']\n", " val_auc = evaluation(model, val_dloader)['AUROC']\n", " train_aucs.append(train_auc)\n", " val_aucs.append(val_auc)\n", "\n", " end_time = AUROC is {round(val_auc, 3)}, \"\n", " f\"Time: {round(end_time - start_time, 2)}s\"\n", " )\n", "\n", " # If early stopping needed\n", " if val_auc > best_val_auc:\n", " best_val_auc = val_auc\n", " best_weights = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}\n", " patience_count = 0\n", " else:\n", " patience_count += 1\n", "\n", " if patience_count >= patience:\n", " print(f\"Early stop at epoch {epoch+1}\")\n", " break\n", "\n", " # Loss over iterations\n", " plt.title(\"Training Curve\")\n", " plt.plot(iters, losses, label=\"Train\")\n", " plt.xlabel(\"Iterations\")\n", " plt.ylabel(\"Loss\")\n", " plt.show()\n", "\n", " # AUROC over epochs\n", " plt.title(\"Training Curve\")\n", " plt.plot(epch, train_aucs, label=\"Train\")\n", " plt.plot(epch, val_aucs, print(f\"Final Validation AUROC is {val_aucs[-1]}\")\n", "\n", " # Load best weights\n", " model.load_state_dict(best_weights)\n", " return model, best_val_auc\n" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", torch.no_grad():\n", " for ab, ag, lab in dloader:\n", " ab = ab.to(device)\n", " ag = ag.to(device)\n", " predictions = model(ab, ag)\n", " all_predictions.extend(predictions.cpu().numpy())\n", " all_labels.extend(lab.numpy())\n", "\n", " all_predictions = np.array(all_predictions)\n", " all_labels = np.array(all_labels)\n", "\n", " auroc = roc_auc_score(all_labels, all_predictions)\n", " auprc = average_precision_score(all_labels, all_predictions)\n", " binary_predictions = (all_predictions > 0.5).astype(int)\n", " f1 = f1_score(all_labels, binary_predictions)\n", "\n", " return {\n", " \"AUROC\": round(auroc, 3),\n", " \"AUPRC\": round(auprc, 3),\n", " \"F1\": round(f1,3),\n", " \"preds\": all_predictions,\n", " \"labs\": all_labels\n", "}\n" ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dimension),\n", " nn.Linear(hidden_dimension, hidden_dimension//2), # Hidden layer 1\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(hidden_dimension//2,1), # Hidden def __init__(self, embedding_dimension=1280, dropout=0.3):\n", " super().__init__()\n", " self.projection = nn.Linear(embedding_dimension, 128) # Compresses each embedding from 1,280 to 128 to form IM\n", " self.features = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, padding=1), # Conv block 1\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.BatchNorm2d(32),\n", " nn.MaxPool2d(2),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1), # Conv block 2\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.BatchNorm2d(64),\n", " nn.MaxPool2d(2),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout)\n", " )\n", "\n", " self.global_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1) # Collapses 32x32 spatial map into single value\n", "\n", " self.classifier = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(64, 32),\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(32, 1),\n", " nn.Sigmoid() # Probability of binding\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Forward propagation function\n", " def forward(self, antibody, antigen):\n", " interaction = torch.bmm(self.projection(antibody).unsqueeze(2), self.projection(antigen).unsqueeze(1)) # Batched matrix multiplication produces 128 x 128 IM\n", " interaction = interaction.unsqueeze(1)\n", " x = self.features(interaction)\n", " x = self.global_pool(x).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)\n", " return self.classifier(x).squeeze(-1)" ], "metadata": { "id": "giqSTzzzqRs7" }, "execution_count": null, "outputs": [] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "source": [ "LSTM:" ], "metadata": { "id": "65hxNCwO2xAV" } }, { "cell_type": "code", "source": [ "# 2 token sequence through bidirectional stacked LSTM -> Classifier head\n", "# Bidirectional processes ab->ag and ag->ab, following course Week 7 extension\n", "class LSTMClassifier(nn.Module):\n", " def __init__(self, embedding_dimension=1280, hidden_dimension=128,\n", " num_layers=2, dropout=0.3):\n", " super().__init__()\n", " self.hidden_dimension = hidden_dimension\n", " self.num_layers = num_layers\n", "\n", " self.rnn = nn.LSTM(\n", " input_size=embedding_dimension,\n", " hidden_size=hidden_dimension,\n", " num_layers=num_layers,\n", " batch_first=True,\n", " bidirectional=True, # Processes ab->ag and ag->ab\n", " dropout=dropout\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Input doubles due to bidirectional concatenation\n", " self.out = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(hidden_dimension * 2, hidden_dimension),\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(hidden_dimension, 1),\n", " nn.Sigmoid()\n", " )\n", "\n", " def forward(self, antibody, antigen):\n", " x = torch.stack([antibody, antigen], dim=1)\n", " r_out, hidden_state = self.rnn(x)\n", " last_output = r_out[:, -1, :] # Final timestep, both directions\n", " return self.out(last_output).squeeze(-1)" ], "metadata": { "id": "wsOuKglb2x8R" }, "execution_count": null, "outputs": [] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "source": [ "GRU:" ], "metadata": { "id": "L4S_nsnN2yL9" } }, { "cell_type": "code", "source": [ "# Identical architecture to LSTM with nn.GRU swapped in for clean parameter-efficient comparison\n", "class GRUClassifier(nn.Module):\n", " def __init__(self, embedding_dimension=1280, hidden_dimension=128, num_layers=2, dropout=0.3):\n", " super().__init__()\n", " self.hidden_dimension = hidden_dimension\n", " self.num_layers = num_layers\n", "\n", " self.rnn = nn.GRU(\n", " input_size=embedding_dimension,\n", " hidden_size=hidden_dimension,\n", " num_layers=num_layers, # Stacked: lower layers learn local features, upper layers learn global features\n", " batch_first=True,\n", " bidirectional=True, # Unidirectional: ab then ag\n", " dropout=dropout # Inter-layer dropout\n", " )\n", "\n", " self.out = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(hidden_dimension * 2, hidden_dimension), # Hidden layer\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(hidden_dimension, 1),\n", " nn.Sigmoid() # Probability of binding\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Forward propagation function\n", " def forward(self, antibody, antigen):\n", " x = torch.stack([antibody, antigen], dim=1) # 2 token sequence stack, ab = 0, ag = 1\n", " r_out, hidden_state = self.rnn(x) # Runs GRU over 2 token sequence\n", " last_output = r_out[:, -1, :] # Use final time step output\n", " return self.out(last_output).squeeze(-1)" ], "metadata": { "id": "evlZBOez2zBt" }, "execution_count": null, "outputs": [] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "source": [ "Transformer:" ], "metadata": { "id": "I1TxmWMJy00h" } }, { "cell_type": "code", "source": [ "# Multi-head Cross-attention Transformer\n", "# ab -> ag & ag -> ab, then directly models molecular interaction between the two proteins\n", "class CrossAttentionTransformer(nn.Module):\n", " def __init__(self, embedding_dimension=1280,\n", " projected_dimension=256, num_heads=4,\n", " num_layers=2, feedforward_dimension=512,\n", " dropout=0.1):\n", " super().__init__()\n", "\n", " # Project embeddings to lower dimension\n", " self.ab_projection = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(embedding_dimension, projected_dimension),\n", " nn.BatchNorm1d(projected_dimension)\n", " )\n", " self.ag_projection = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(embedding_dimension, projected_dimension),\n", " nn.BatchNorm1d(projected_dimension)\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Cross attention: ab to ag\n", " self.cross_attention_ab = nn.MultiheadAttention(\n", " embed_dim=projected_dimension,\n", " num_heads=num_heads,\n", " dropout=dropout,\n", " batch_first=True\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Cross attention: ag to ab\n", " self.cross_attention_ag = nn.MultiheadAttention(\n", " embed_dim=projected_dimension,\n", " num_heads=num_heads,\n", " dropout=dropout,\n", " batch_first=True\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Feedforward layers after cross attention\n", " self.feedforward_ab = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(projected_dimension, feedforward_dimension),\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(feedforward_dimension, projected_dimension)\n", " )\n", " self.feedforward_ag = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(projected_dimension, feedforward_dimension),\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(feedforward_dimension, projected_dimension)\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Layer normalisation\n", " self.norm_ab = nn.LayerNorm(projected_dimension)\n", " self.norm_ag = nn.LayerNorm(projected_dimension)\n", "\n", " # Classification head\n", " self.out = nn.Sequential(\n", " nn.Linear(projected_dimension * 2, 128),\n", " nn.ReLU(),\n", " nn.Dropout(dropout),\n", " nn.Linear(128, 1),\n", " nn.Sigmoid()\n", " )\n", "\n", " def forward(self, antibody, antigen):\n", " # Project embeddings\n", " ab = self.ab_projection(antibody).unsqueeze(1) # (B, 1, 256)\n", " ag = self.ag_projection(antigen).unsqueeze(1)\n", "\n", " # Cross attention: ab to ag\n", " ab_attended, ab_attention_weights = self.cross_attention_ab(\n", " query=ab, key=ag, value=ag,\n", " need_weights=True,\n", " average_attn_weights=False\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Cross attention: ag to ab\n", " ag_attended, ag_attention_weights = self.cross_attention_ag(\n", " query=ag, key=ab, value=ab,\n", " need_weights=True,\n", " average_attn_weights=False\n", " )\n", "\n", " # Residual connections and layer norm\n", " ab_out = self.norm_ab(ab + ab_attended)\n", " ag_out = self.norm_ag(ag + ag_attended)\n", "\n", " # Feedforward\n", " ab_out = ab_out + self.feedforward_ab(ab_out)\n", " ag_out = ag_out + self.feedforward_ag(ag_out)\n", "\n", " # Concatenate and classify\n", " ab_pooled = ab_out.squeeze(1) # (B, 256)\n", " ag_pooled = ag_out.squeeze(1) # (B, 256)\n", " combined = torch.cat([ab_pooled, ag_pooled], dim=1) # (B, 512)\n", " return self.out(combined).squeeze(-1)" ], "metadata": { "id": "SVUWKWPxy2wV" }, "execution_count": null, "outputs": [] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "source": [ "Baseline (MLP and CNN) results:" ],
